paite: Abib kha tang unla, TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in Paikan Ankuangluina ding in zang un. Abib kha in ahi, TOUPA na Pathian un Aigupta gam a pan zan a ahon pikhiak.
heading: Paikan Kut / (Eks 12.1-20)
english: Observe the month of Abib, and keep the Passover to Yahweh your God; for in the month of Abib Yahweh your God brought you out of Egypt by night.

paite: TOUPA'N amin omna mun dia aseh ding ah TOUPA na Pathian kiang uah na belamhon lak ua leh na ganhon lak ua Paikan Ankuang ding in na kithoih ding uh ahi.
english: You shall sacrifice the Passover to Yahweh your God, of the flock and the herd, in the place which Yahweh shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.

paite: Tanghou silngou soh toh na ne ding uh ahi kei. Na damsung teng ua Aigupta gam a pan na pawt ni uh na theihgigena ding un ni sagih tanghou silngou soh louh, haksatna tanghou toh na nek ding uh ahi, Aigupta gam a pan kintak a pawtkhia na hi uhi.
english: You shall eat no leavened bread with it. You shall eat unleavened bread with it seven days, even the bread of affliction (for you came out of the land of Egypt in haste) that you may remember the day when you came out of the land of Egypt all the days of your life.

paite: Na gamsung uah ni sagih sung, na lak uah silngou muh in a-om ding ahi kei. Ani khat ni nitaklam a na kithoihna sa uh zankhua in azingsang tan in bangmah a-om ding ahi kei.
english: No yeast shall be seen with you in all your borders seven days; neither shall any of the meat, which you sacrifice the first day at evening, remain all night until the morning.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak na omna uh koi lai mah ah Paikan Ankuang kithoih in na kithoih thei kei ding uhi.
english: You may not sacrifice the Passover within any of your gates which Yahweh your God gives you;

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un amin omna mun dia aseh ding kia ah ahi ding. Huai ah Aigupta gam a pan na hong pawt hun bang un nitaklam in Paikan Ankuang kithoih in na kithoih ding uhi.
english: but at the place which Yahweh your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell in, there you shall sacrifice the Passover at evening, at the going down of the sun, at the season that you came out of Egypt.

paite: Na em ding ua, TOUPA'N amun seh ding ah na ne ding ua, zingsang in na pai nawn ding ua, na puanin uah na lut ding uhi.
english: You shall roast and eat it in the place which Yahweh your God chooses. In the morning you shall return to your tents.

paite: Ni guk sung tanghou silngou soh louh na ne ding uh ahi. Ani sagih ni pen TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in khawmpi siangthou ahi dia, nna na sem ding uh ahi kei hi.
english: Six days you shall eat unleavened bread. On the seventh day shall be a solemn assembly to Yahweh your God. You shall do no work.

paite: Nipikal sagih na sim ding ua; na buhlak tung ua kipan nipikal sagih na sim ding uhi.
heading: Pawltak Kut / (Eks 34.22; Lev 23.15-21)
english: You shall count for yourselves seven weeks. From the time you begin to put the sickle to the standing grain you shall begin to count seven weeks.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un ahon vualzawl bang zel in na sepkhiak uh lak a noumau ut thu a thillat lan in TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in Nipikal Ankuanglui na nei ding uh ahi.
english: You shall keep the feast of weeks to Yahweh your God with a tribute of a free will offering of your hand, which you shall give according to how Yahweh your God blesses you.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un amin omna dia aseh ding ah na sikhanute uh, na tenna ua om Levite, na lak ua om gamdang mite, pa neiloute, meithaite toh TOUPA na Pathian uh ma ah kipaktak in na om ding uhi.
english: You shall rejoice before Yahweh your God: you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, the Levite who is within your gates, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow who are among you, in the place which Yahweh your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.

paite: Aigupta gam ah sikha na hi uh, chih na theihgige ding uh ahi. Hiai dante pilvangtak in na zui ding uh ahi.
english: You shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt. You shall observe and do these statutes.

paite: Na buhphual ua kipan leh na uain sukna khuk ua kipan na sekkhawm khit un ni sagih sung Biakbuk Ankuanglui na nei ding uhi.
heading: Biakbuk Ankuangluina / (Lev 23.33-43)
english: You shall keep the feast of booths seven days, after you have gathered in from your threshing floor and from your wine press.

paite: Na ankuangluina uah nou toh, na tapa uh toh, na tanu uh toh, na sikhanu uh toh, na tenna ua om Levite, gamdang mite, pa neiloute, meithaite toh kipaktak in na om ding uhi.
english: You shall rejoice in your feast, you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow who are within your gates.

paite: TOUPA'N amun seh ding ah TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in ni sagih ankuang na lui ding uhi. TOUPA na Pathian un thil tung tengteng ah leh na khut ngakna tengteng uah ahon vualzawl dia, na vek un kipaktak in na om ding uh ahi.
english: You shall keep a feast to Yahweh your God seven days in the place which Yahweh chooses, because Yahweh your God will bless you in all your increase and in all the work of your hands, and you shall be altogether joyful.

paite: Kum teng in na pasal tengteng uh thumvei TOUPA ma ah mun hon sehsak ding ah akilang ding uh ahi. Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ankuang ah, Nipikal Ankuang ah, Biakbuk Ankuang ah akilang ding ua, TOUPA ma ah kuamah khutvuak in na kilang ding uh ahi kei.
english: Three times in a year all of your males shall appear before Yahweh your God in the place which he chooses: in the feast of unleavened bread, in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of booths. They shall not appear before Yahweh empty.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un vualzawlna ahon muhsak bang zel in michih in azoh hun bang in ape ding ahi.
english: Every man shall give as he is able, according to Yahweh your God’s blessing which he has given you.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak kulh kongpi tengteng ah na nam bang zel un vaihawmte leh heutute na kibawl chiat ding ua, mipite vai hoihtak in ahawmsak ding uh ahi.
heading: Dik A Vaihawmna
english: You shall make judges and officers in all your gates, which Yahweh your God gives you, according to your tribes; and they shall judge the people with righteous judgment.

paite: Dik loutak in vai na hawm ding uh ahi kei. Kuamah deihsak tuam na nei ding uh ahi kei. Golhgukna na la ding uh ahi kei. Golhgukna in mipilte mit atawsak a, midiktatte thu akaikawi hi.
english: You shall not pervert justice. You shall not show partiality. You shall not take a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and perverts the words of the righteous.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak gam dam a na luahtheihna ding un adik kia na zui ding uh ahi.
english: You shall follow that which is altogether just, that you may live and inherit the land which Yahweh your God gives you.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh maitam na bawl chiang un apang ah sing bangchi mah in leng Asher na phutkhe ding uh ahi kei.
english: You shall not plant for yourselves an Asherah of any kind of tree beside Yahweh your God’s altar, which you shall make for yourselves.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un amuhdah lam suang leng na phut ding uh ahi sam kei hi.
english: Neither shall you set yourself up a sacred stone which Yahweh your God hates.
